title: Investigation
description: Causing an investigation to be made if a prima facie case exists

steps.step: Satisfaction that there exists a prima facie case
Causing investigation to be made by the Director-General or by the District Collector
The Central Authority, the Director-General or the District Collector may call upon a person referred to in sub-section (1)
The person may be directed to produce any document or record in his possession

documents: any document or record in his possession
